data.title: A Rough Instantaneous Squared VIX Model for Term Structure and Option Pricing
data.summary: The VIX term structure provides forward-looking measures of market uncertainty across horizons, while VIX options allow investors to hedge volatility risk. This paper proposes a rough instantaneous squared VIX (RISVIX) model by introducing fractional memory into the conventional Markovian framework.
